schemas.title: Dataset Metadata
schemas.description: Study-level metadata for a neuroimaging dataset. Contains what modalities are present, participant demographics (from participants.tsv), signal properties shared across recordings, event/HED annotation status, and provenance. Aligned with BIDS dataset_description.json and participants.tsv. Platform-neutral; platform-specific fields belong in extensions.

schema_version.description: Envelope field: schema version (present when validated through root schema).

doc_type.description: Envelope field: document type (present when validated through root schema).

dataset_id.description: Unique dataset identifier (e.g., 'ds003645' for OpenNeuro, 'nm000108' for NEMAR).

description.description: Short abstract or description of the dataset.

recording_modality.description: Recording modalities present in the dataset (e.g., ['EEG', 'MEG', 'MRI']). Dataset-level property; individual data files inherit their modality from the BIDS datatype directory.

bids_version.description: BIDS specification version the dataset follows.

authors.description: List of dataset authors as structured person objects.

funding.description: Funding sources with structured grant information.

funder_identifier.description: Persistent identifier for the funder (e.g., Crossref Funder ID, ROR ID).

award_uri.description: URI to the award or grant information page.

tasks.description: Experimental tasks present in the dataset.

datatypes.description: BIDS datatype directories present in the dataset (e.g., ['eeg', 'anat']).

sessions.description: Session labels present in the dataset (e.g., ['pre', 'post']).

sessions_count.description: Number of sessions in the dataset.

has_hed_annotations.description: Whether the dataset includes Hierarchical Event Descriptors (HED) annotations.

hed_version.description: Version of the HED schema used for annotations (e.g., '8.1.0').

has_event_annotations.description: Whether the dataset includes event/stimulus annotations (events.tsv files).

keywords.description: Subject terms and keywords for findability. Supports both plain keywords (term only) and controlled vocabulary entries (with scheme and URI). Aligns with DataCite Subject (property 6).

related_identifiers.description: Related resources: associated papers, source datasets, code repositories, prior versions. These links feed into scholarly knowledge graphs and citation indices. Aligns with DataCite RelatedIdentifier (property 12).

contributors.description: Contributors with typed roles beyond the primary authors. Includes data collectors, hosting institutions, project leaders, etc. Aligns with DataCite Contributor (property 7).

dates.description: Semantically typed dates: data collection period, creation date, publication date, etc. Aligns with DataCite Date (property 8).

rights.description: Structured license/rights entries with URIs and machine-readable identifiers. Complements the simpler 'license' string field. Aligns with DataCite Rights (property 16).

language.description: Primary language of the dataset content (IETF BCP 47 tag, e.g., 'en'). Aligns with DataCite Language (property 9).

schemas.title: Person
schemas.description: A structured person record for authors or contributors. Includes name components, ORCID, and affiliations for DataCite compatibility.

name_type.description: Whether this is a person or organization. Defaults to Personal if omitted.

schemas.title: Demographics
schemas.description: Subject demographics summary at the dataset level.

subjects_count.description: Total number of subjects in the dataset.

schemas.title: Data Summary
schemas.description: Aggregate statistics about the data content of a dataset. These are computed summaries across all recordings (ranges, counts, distributions).

total_files.description: Total number of files in the dataset.

recording_count.description: Total number of recordings (data files) in the dataset.

channel_count_range.description: Range of channel counts across recordings in this dataset.

channel_type_summary.description: Summary counts of channel types across the dataset (e.g., {'EEG': 64, 'EOG': 2, 'ECG': 1}).

sampling_frequency_range.description: Range of sampling frequencies across recordings (if they vary).

data_processed.description: Whether the dataset contains processed (vs. raw) data.

schemas.title: Inheritable Signal Properties
schemas.description: Signal properties that follow the BIDS inheritance pattern: the dataset provides defaults and individual records can override them. Used in both dataset.signal_defaults and record.signal_properties.

power_line_frequency.description: Power line frequency in Hz (typically 50 or 60).

placement_scheme.description: Detailed electrode placement scheme from BIDS EEG sidecar (e.g., 'extended 10-10% system').

schemas.title: Provenance
schemas.description: Timestamps and origin tracking for the metadata document.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the dataset was first created/published.

ingested_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this metadata was ingested into the system.

latest_snapshot.description: Latest version/snapshot identifier of the dataset (e.g., '2.0.2').

uploader.description: Name of the person who uploaded the dataset.

schemas.title: Subject/Keyword
schemas.description: A structured subject term with optional controlled vocabulary linkage. Aligns with DataCite Subject (property 6). Supports free-text keywords and terms from controlled vocabularies like MeSH, Cognitive Atlas, or Library of Congress Subject Headings.

term.description: The subject term or keyword text.

subject_scheme.description: Name of the controlled vocabulary or classification scheme (e.g., 'MeSH', 'Cognitive Atlas', 'LCSH', 'Fields of Science and Technology (FOS)').

value_uri.description: URI identifying this specific subject term within the scheme.

classification_code.description: Classification code within the scheme (e.g., MeSH tree number, ANZSRC code). Use when the scheme does not provide per-term URIs.

schemas.title: Related Identifier
schemas.description: A link to a related resource with typed relationship. Aligns with DataCite RelatedIdentifier (property 12). Supports DOIs, URLs, PMIDs, arXiv IDs, and other persistent identifier types. These links feed into citation graphs and scholarly knowledge graphs.

identifier.description: The identifier value (e.g., '10.1234/example' for DOI, 'https://example.com' for URL).

identifier_type.description: Type of the identifier. Inferred from format if omitted.

relation_type.description: Relationship of the identified resource to this dataset. Framed as: this dataset [relation_type] the related resource.

resource_type_general.description: General type of the related resource (not this dataset). Enables graph-based filtering by resource type.

related_metadata_scheme.description: Name of the metadata scheme. Only applicable when relation_type is HasMetadata or IsMetadataFor.

schemas.title: Contributor
schemas.description: A contributor with a typed role, beyond the primary authors/creators. Aligns with DataCite Contributor (property 7). Common roles for neuroimaging datasets include DataCollector, ProjectLeader, and HostingInstitution.

name.description: Full display name (e.g., 'Jane A. Smith' or 'NEMAR').

given_name.description: Given (first) name. Omit for organizational contributors.

family_name.description: Family (last) name. Omit for organizational contributors.

name_type.description: Whether this is a person or organization.

schemas.title: Structured Date
schemas.description: A date with semantic type. Aligns with DataCite Date (property 8). Supports single dates, date ranges (YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD), and year-only precision. Use 'Collected' for data acquisition periods, 'Issued' for publication date, 'Created' for dataset creation.

date_information.description: Free-text detail about the date (e.g., 'EEG recording sessions' for a Collected date).

schemas.title: Rights
schemas.description: A structured rights/license entry with URI and machine-readable identifier. Aligns with DataCite Rights (property 16). Complements the simpler 'license' string field in core by providing full SPDX identifiers and URIs needed for DOI registration and FAIR compliance.

rights.description: Human-readable rights statement (e.g., 'Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International').

schemas.title: External Links
schemas.description: Relevant external hyperlinks for the dataset.

source_url.description: URL to the primary data source (e.g., OpenNeuro page).

references_and_links.description: List of references and publication links.

dataset_doi.description: Digital Object Identifier for the dataset.

associated_paper_doi.description: DOI of the primary associated paper.

osf_url.description: URL to the Open Science Framework (OSF) project.

github_url.description: URL to the associated GitHub repository.

paper_url.description: URL to the primary associated paper (if not a DOI).

schemas.title: Extensions Container
schemas.description: Container for domain-specific extensions using reserved namespaces. Each project or domain gets its own namespace. Adding new top-level namespaces requires a schema version bump. Follows the pattern established by signalJourney's extension system.

signalJourney.description: Namespace for signalJourney processing pipeline metadata.

nemar.description: Namespace for NEMAR-specific properties (API fields, legacy fields).

dataQuality.description: Namespace for data quality metrics and indicators.

rawDetail.description: Namespace for detailed per-channel arrays (channel names, types, TSV data). Separated from core to keep core documents lean.

dataCite.description: Namespace for DataCite DOI registration metadata (publisher, resource type, geo_locations, alternate_identifiers, related_items). Note: keywords, related_identifiers, contributors, dates, rights, and language moved to core in v0.3.0.

dataCategories.description: Namespace for study classification (paradigm, clinical context, cognitive domains).

x-extension-managers.description: Maps each extension namespace to its owning service and MongoDB collection. Core fields are platform-neutral; extension collections have separate access control per service.

schemas.title: EEGDash Extension
schemas.description: EEGDash-specific metadata for visualization and streaming. Fields that support the EEGDash dashboard but are not part of the core neuroschema.

storage.description: Storage location details for EEGDash backend.

base.description: Base URI for the storage location.

raw_key.description: Relative path key to the raw file.

senior_author.description: Senior/corresponding author name for display purposes.

contact_info.description: Contact information for the dataset (email or URL).

ages.description: Raw array of participant ages. Core has summary statistics only (age_min, age_max, age_mean); this holds the full distribution.

schemas.title: signalJourney Extension
schemas.description: Namespace for linking to signalJourney processing pipeline records. References processing provenance tracked in signalJourney's own schema.

pipeline_id.description: Identifier for the signalJourney pipeline associated with this record/dataset.

sj_version.description: Version of the signalJourney specification used.

schemas.title: NEMAR Extension
schemas.description: NEMAR-specific properties that extend the core schema. Includes fields from the NEMAR API and nemar.json that are not part of the universal core.

on_brainlife.description: Whether the dataset is available on BrainLife.

has_visualization.description: Whether NEMAR has generated visualizations for this dataset.

nemar_json.description: Contents of the nemar.json file (warnings, plots, channel system info).

local_dataset.description: Whether a local copy of the dataset is maintained by NEMAR.

processed.description: Whether NEMAR has processed this dataset.

hed_annotation.description: Whether the dataset has HED annotations (from NEMAR processing).

citation_count.description: Number of papers citing this dataset (from NEMAR citations repository).

schemas.title: Data Quality Extension
schemas.description: Namespace for data quality metrics and indicators. Placeholder for future data quality assessment projects.

quality_flags.description: List of quality flags or issues identified.

assessed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the quality assessment was performed.

schemas.title: Raw Detail Extension
schemas.description: Detailed per-channel arrays and raw BIDS sidecar content. This extension holds the verbose data that was previously in the core MongoDB documents (channel_names, channel_types, channel_tsv, eeg_json). Separated from core to allow lean queries that skip large arrays.

channel_types.description: Ordered list of channel types (parallel to channel_names).

channel_tsv.description: Parsed content of the BIDS channels.tsv file.

eeg_json.description: Parsed content of the BIDS EEG sidecar JSON (*_eeg.json). Contains task description, equipment info, filter settings, etc.

participant_tsv.description: Parsed row from the BIDS participants.tsv for this subject.

bids_dependencies.description: List of BIDS sidecar file paths that this record depends on.

electrode_tsv.description: Parsed content of the BIDS electrodes.tsv file (electrode names, coordinates).

events_tsv.description: Parsed content of the BIDS events.tsv file (onset, duration, trial_type columns).

schemas.title: DataCite Extension
schemas.description: DataCite-specific metadata for DOI registration (kernel 4.6). Fields here are specific to the DataCite registration format and are not universally needed. Universal scholarly metadata (keywords, related_identifiers, contributors, dates, rights, language) has moved to the core dataset schema as of v0.3.0.

publisher.description: Name of the entity that holds/publishes the data (e.g., 'NEMAR', 'OpenNeuro').

publisher_identifier.description: Persistent identifier for the publisher (e.g., ROR ID for the institution).

publication_year.description: Year when the dataset was first published or made available.

resource_type.description: Free-text description of the resource type (e.g., 'EEG Dataset', 'EMG Dataset').

resource_type_general.description: DataCite controlled vocabulary for general resource type.

geo_locations.description: Geographic locations where the data was collected or about which the data is focused. Coordinates use WGS 84.

place.description: Free-text description of the location (e.g., 'Fudan University, Shanghai, China').

alternate_identifiers.description: Other identifiers for this dataset besides the DOI (e.g., platform-specific IDs like 'nm000108' for NEMAR, 'ds005516' for OpenNeuro).

identifier_type.description: Type or source of the alternate identifier (e.g., 'NEMAR', 'OpenNeuro', 'PhysioNet').

related_items.description: Full bibliographic references for related items (DataCite property 20). Use when you need to cite a resource with complete bibliographic detail (title, authors, journal, pages) rather than just an identifier link.

relation_type.description: Relationship of the related item to this dataset.

publication_year.description: Publication year of the related item.

schemas.title: Data Categories Extension
schemas.description: Study classification metadata for filtering and discovery. Captures the experimental paradigm, clinical context, and cognitive domains of the dataset.

is_clinical.description: Whether the dataset involves clinical populations.
